description: Reconstruction groups. Each group defines a target reconstruction geometry: source scan modes it applies to, the fdkPara.xml field values to overwrite (absolute targets, copied from real Mode1/2/3 configurations), and the standard filter.xml file to use (whole-file replacement, no runtime parameter overrides). filter_file is per-group on purpose: groups with the same FOV but different modes (e.g. Mode2_1609 vs Mode3_1609) or different FOVs of the same mode (e.g. Mode2_1609 vs Mode2_0808) are expected to diverge in filter parameters over time, so each group keeps its own copy. A study is reconstructed once per matching group (same mode -> all groups).
